q: The structure and function of biological components are (A. isolated B. separated C. interrelated D. connected). (2025- Set 10)
e: Biological components interact in an interrelated manner within biological systems.

q: The cell is a basic unit structure and (A. function B. tasking C. loading D. making) of an organism. (2025- Set 5)
e: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms.

q: The genetic information is encoded in the nucleotide sequences of (A. RNA B. DNA C. mRNA D. tRNA). (2026- Set 2)
e: Genetic information in living organisms is stored in the nucleotide sequences of DNA.

q: The genetic information is encoded in the (A. nucleotide B. nucleoside C. nucleic acid D. ribonucleic acid) sequences of DNA. (2025- Set 7)
e: Nucleotides form the building blocks and sequence that encodes genetic information in DNA.

q: Producers convert energy from sunlight to (A. potential B. chemical C. kinetic D. gravitational) energy and some of which is then passed to consumers. (2025- Set 9)
e: Photosynthetic producers convert light energy into chemical energy stored in organic molecules.

q: Organisms interact continuously with (A. physical, B. chemical, C. internal, D. environmental) factors. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား/2025-Set 2)
e: Organisms continuously interact with physical factors in their ecosystem.

q: Natural selection is defined as the (A. environmental, B. chemical, C. functional, D. evolutionary) process. (2024-Set 2)
e: Natural selection is a primary mechanism driving the evolutionary process.

q: (A. Olericulture B. Floriculture C. Viticulture D. Arboriculture) is the growing and marketing of flowers and ornamental plants for floristry. (2025- Set 11)
e: Floriculture specifically refers to the cultivation and marketing of flowering and ornamental plants.

q: The most requirement for traditional rice cultivating method is (A. fertilizer B. pest control C. weed control D. irrigation planning). (2025- Set 4)
e: Traditional rice farming relies heavily on proper water management and irrigation planning.

q: Wheat is a grass widely cultivated for its (A. buds B. seeds C. flowers D. stem). (2026-Set 1)(2025- Set 3)
e: Wheat is a cereal grain cultivated primarily for its nutrient-rich seeds.

q: Among the ASEAN countries, Myanmar is the leading (A. pulse, B. rice, C. wheat, D. maize) and bean producer. (2024-Set 3)
e: Myanmar is a major producer and exporter of pulse crops and beans in Southeast Asia.

q: Pomology is the production of (A. herbaceous plants, B. fruits and nuts, C. flowers, D. grapes). (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Pomology is a branch of horticulture that focuses on the study and cultivation of fruits and nuts.

q: Livestock contribute to the conservation of biodiversity and (A. genetic B. physical C. natural D. ecological) resources for food and agriculture. (2025- Set 6)
e: Livestock play a critical role in maintaining genetic resources essential for agricultural diversity.

q: Livestock are key drivers for sustainable development in (A. aquaculture B. agriculture C. floriculture D. olericulture). (2025- Set 9)
e: Livestock farming forms an integral part of agricultural development and sustainability.

q: Plant only is able to manufacture food through the process of (A. guttation B. photosynthesis C. transpiration D. respiration). (2025- Set 1,3)
e: Photosynthesis is the key process by which plants produce organic food using light energy.

q: Yeast, one of the simplest (.A. prokaryotes B. eukaryotes C. bacteria D. protists) is used in the process of fermentation. (2025- Set 10)
e: Yeast is a single-celled eukaryotic fungus used extensively in fermentation.

q: Digitalis is obtained from the (A. leaves B. fruits C. roots D. seeds) of foxglove plant. (2026- နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Digitalis is extracted primarily from the dried leaves of the foxglove plant.

q: Two powerful pain relieved compounds, morphine and codeine are extracted from (A. Cinchona sp. B. Papaver somniferum C. Digitalis purpurea D. Dipterocarpus alatus). (2025- Set 8)
e: Morphine and codeine are natural analgesic alkaloids derived from the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum.

q: The bark of cinchona tree, contains quinine a drug used to treat (A. malaria B. heart disease C. liver D. leukemia). (2025- Set 13)
e: Answer key selected option C according to the textbook key.

q: Morphine and codeine are extracted from (A. willow tree B. cinchona tree C. opium poppy D. foxglove plant). (2025- Set 12)
e: Answer key selected option A according to the textbook key.

q: Plant fibres are (A. parenchymatous B. collenchymatous C. aerenchymatous D. sclerenchymatous) cells and are parts of the plant skeleton. (2026-Set 2)
e: Plant fibres are composed of thick-walled sclerenchymatous cells providing structural support.

q: Plant fibres are (A. sclerenchymatous, B. parenchymatous, C. collenchymatous, D. chlorenchyma) cells. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အချို့အတွက်မေး/2025-Set 2)
e: Plant fibres consist of sclerenchymatous tissue that supports mechanical strength.

q: Structurally, plant fibres are (A. parenchymatous, B. sclerenchymatous, C. collenchymatous, D. aerenchymatous) cells and are parts of the plant skeleton. (2024-Set 4)
e: Structurally, plant fibres are made up of sclerenchymatous cells acting as the plant skeleton.
